selection: Rank symbols using net cash P&L of baseline trades both entered and exited in 2023-2024. Remove top1/top3, rerun actual portfolio including shadow gate. Full-period top3 is retrospective fragility diagnostic only.
regime: BTC previous 180 completed 4h bars return at signal knowledge; UP >5%, DOWN <-5%, otherwise SIDEWAYS; missing ->UNKNOWN. No future prices.
filter_rule: Per engine, use baseline 2023-2024 trades completed before cutoff; exclude the single lowest-net regime only if count>=30 and net<0. Freeze exclusions before 2025/2026 comparison. Filtering removes signals including shadow outcomes: new strategy variant, not posthoc subtraction.
limits: Same frozen capital/risk/sizing/leverage/alpha; double fee/slip only; funding historical trade proxy; 38 preselected symbols; previously consulted history; no independent OOS or live promotion.
